##### Project general facts

The Level is a waterfront residential tower by BI Group, set directly on the community's crystal lagoon. The building rises above a ground floor with a lobby and retail units and podium parking levels, with a dedicated amenity level and residential floors above. The residences comprise one- and two-bedroom apartments with efficient layouts, natural light and private balconies connecting the homes to their lagoon-side surroundings.

The amenity level extends the experience of home with spaces to exercise, unwind, work, play and spend time with others. Water and leisure facilities include an infinity-edge leisure pool with a canopy, poolside sunbeds, a kids' pool and a relaxation lounge, while wellness is covered by a fitness centre, an outdoor gym, pilates and yoga areas, and a steam room and sauna. Residents also have a barbecue deck with a dining area, a clubhouse with a lounge and kitchenette, a co-working space, a games area, sunken and garden lounges, an indoor kids' area and an outdoor playground.

The entrance lobby showcases warm materials and thoughtful detailing that ease the transition from cityscape to home sanctuary. Interiors are finished with contemporary touches, presenting open living spaces that encourage everyday rituals and gatherings with friends. Overall, the residences are equipped with modern finishing and high‑quality materials throughout. 

##### Location description and benefits

Meydan Horizon is an emerging urban destination in Dubai where the energy of the city meets landscaped open spaces and waterfront surroundings. The master community is built around a wide crystal lagoon and a long retail promenade, with parks, schools, nurseries, clinics and a mosque planned within the neighbourhood. A planned Golden Line metro station will add a direct public transport link across the city.

The community enjoys direct road links to the city's key destinations. Downtown Dubai and The Dubai Mall, Dubai Design District, DIFC, Meydan Racecourse and Dubai International Airport are all within a short drive. The neighbouring Ras Al Khor Wildlife Sanctuary, a protected wetland known for its seasonal flamingos, adds a rare natural setting to the area.

Meydan Horizon appeals to end users and investors seeking a central, well-connected address with resort-style lagoon living. The mix of one- and two-bedroom homes suits professionals, couples and young families, and supports steady rental demand close to Dubai's main business districts. Tax-free ownership and access to the Dubai Golden Visa add to the appeal for international buyers.
